C-TABLE-BAR-MENU-OVERLAP.Summary: Fix the table drag-pill context menus (TableBarTools: row menu from the left pill, column menu from the bottom pill) so every item renders as a single non-overlapping line in every supported locale. Today the menu fixes its width at 150px and each item height at 25px; labels longer than the 134px content box wrap to a second line that paints on top of the next item (owner-visible in the ru locale: «Вставить строку выше», «Вставить столбец слева/справа»).
C-TABLE-BAR-MENU-OVERLAP.Problem: src/muya/lib/ui/tableTools/index.css pins .ag-table-bar-tools to width: 150px and li.item to height: 25px / line-height: 25px with no white-space control. In locales whose labels exceed the 134px content box (measured live in ru: two-line wrap, li scrollHeight 50 vs clientHeight 25) the wrapped second line is drawn exactly over the following item's text, so both the row and the column menus show superimposed, unreadable items. The geometry was sized for en/CJK labels; ru/de/fr/es/pt overflow it.

Goals.Goal: Every TableBarTools menu item renders its full label on exactly one text line, never overlapping a neighbouring item, in all ten shipped locales (ru included).
The menu grows to fit its longest label (width driven by content, floor at the current 150px so the en geometry does not regress).
The fix stays inside muya's tableTools UI module CSS; no JS logic, locale string, or BaseFloat behaviour changes.

Constraints.Constraint: Fix pattern follows the established muya house style — white-space: nowrap plus content-driven width, the same combination blockViewer already uses — so the BaseFloat element-resize-detector keeps the popper positioned as the menu widens.
The remove-item divider (li[data-label=remove]::before at top: -5px with margin-top: 10px) keeps its designed geometry against single-line 25px items.

Both placement surfaces keep working: the row pill menu (placement right-start of .ag-drag-handler.left) and the column pill menu (right-start of .ag-drag-handler.bottom), including the table-scroll sticky-footer layer where the bottom pill lives (z-index interplay is untouched).
Sibling muya float menus (frontMenu and others) are re-measured for the same wrap trap as evidence only; any fix beyond tableTools goes to a separate change.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No redesign of the drag pills themselves (size, opacity, position), of the menu placement/offset, or of the insert/remove action set.
No locale string edits — the labels are correct; only the menu geometry is wrong.
No BaseFloat/popper changes and no new menu behaviour (keyboard navigation, theming) beyond what the overlap fix requires.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: In the ru locale, opening both pill menus shows three readable single-line items each; DOM measurement asserts for every li.item: scrollHeight equals clientHeight (no wrapped overflow) and the label text range produces exactly one client rect.
Measured menu width is at least 150px in en (no shrink) and grows past 150px in ru to fit the longest label in one line.
The en locale menus are byte-for-byte unchanged visually (single line items, same divider, same placement).
Existing table e2e families stay green: table-layout and table-column-resize in chromium and the webkit-tables project (the WKWebView engine parity), plus the full unit gate.
grace lint reports no new findings for this change (delta clean against the recorded pre-existing baseline).

AffectedAreas.Item: src/muya/lib/ui/tableTools/index.css — the only production file expected to change: menu width strategy (content-driven, min-width floor) and li.item white-space.

tests/e2e/table-bar-menu.spec.ts (new) — locale-geometry spec asserting single-line items and width floor/growth in ru and en; runs in the chromium project and, per the table-*.spec.ts match, the webkit-tables project.
Evidence-only: a one-off probe screenshot set (ru/en, both menus) recorded in the change Evidence; no module contract, graph module, or locale file changes.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: npx playwright test tests/e2e/table-bar-menu.spec.ts --project=chromium && npx playwright test tests/e2e/table-bar-menu.spec.ts --project=webkit-tables && npm test && grace lint --path . --change C-TABLE-BAR-MENU-OVERLAP --assertions final --run-commands
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The new e2e spec's per-item geometry assertions (scrollHeight == clientHeight, one text client rect per item, width floor/growth) passing in both engines; before/after probe screenshots of both menus in ru and en attached as owner-visible acceptance; the full npm test gate green; grace lint delta clean against the recorded pre-existing baseline (the sideBar/tree-treefiles and worktree findings predate this change).

Assumptions.Assumption: The BaseFloat resize-detector path (container offsetWidth changes → floatBox inline width + popper.update) is already exercised by other content-sized muya floats and needs no change for a wider menu.
